Subject: Nonstandard SKU lines on marketplace invoice + VAT tagging question

Hi Claire / CloudOps Billing,

We pulled the December marketplace invoice and see ~2,400 USD of line items flagged under sku 'nonstandard_io' that don't map to any usage we expect (we don't expose a SKU with that name). The lines also have inconsistent VAT flags: some are marked "VAT reverse-charge" while others are blank. Can you: 1) provide the raw per-usage export that generated the invoice (CSV), 2) attach the ratecard mapping used to attribute SKUs to marketplace billing lines, and 3) confirm the VAT treatment you applied for EU customers on those lines?

This is time-sensitive — Finance is blocking the payout for the impacted merchant until we get clarity. If possible, include a concise column-level explanation (source_instance, timestamp, billing_bucket, vat_flag).

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Sergio — thanks for the heads up. Apologies for the surprise lines; attaching the export you asked for and the ratecard mapping. Quick notes from our side: 1) The 'nonstandard_io' SKU is an internal consolidation bucket we use when partner usage doesn't map cleanly to a current ratecard entry (new feature rollouts + probe traffic). 2) VAT flags are applied by our post-aggregation tagging job — there was a partial fail in the EU tagging job on 2026-12-13 which left ~18% of lines untagged.

Attached: CloudOps_usage_export_20261214.csv (per-usage rows, timestamp in UTC), ratecard_mapping_Q4_2026.pdf. I'm also attaching a short CSV extract showing the untagged rows. We'll run a re-tag and can reissue corrected invoice lines, but I need confirmation on whether Redwood wants us to: a) reclassify and issue a credit memo now, or b) hold adjustment to next cycle and provide evidence (Finance preference?).

Claire Huang
Revenue Ops — CloudOps Inc.
billing@cloudopsinc.com

Attachments: CloudOps_usage_export_20261214.csv (CSV), ratecard_mapping_Q4_2026.pdf (PDF), untagged_extract_20261214.csv (CSV)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc:
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 08:34:22 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nonstandard SKU lines on marketplace invoice + VAT tagging question

Thanks for flagging — I pulled the CSV and did a quick join against our marketplace attribution table. Findings: 1) ~92% of the 'nonstandard_io' rows have timestamps between 23:55-00:10 UTC which overlaps our midnight cutover; CloudOps uses a strict UTC rollup at 00:00 while our billing window applies a 15-minute grace cut-to-local semantics for reserved instances. That explains the "nonstandard" consolidation — the partner pipeline collapsed those edge-bucket rows into a catch-all SKU. 2) The rows without VAT flags correspond to customers whose EU tax IDs were present but were not surfaced to CloudOps due to a transient API rate limit on 2026-12-13 (their post-aggregation tagging job failed to fetch tax-attribute enrichment for ~1,120 rows).

Suggested next steps:
- We ask CloudOps to reclassify the 23:55-00:10 UTC rows to the correct SKU mapping and issue a credit memo for the reclassified amount (they will need our marketplace entity IDs — I'll attach mapping).
- Require CloudOps to produce a VAT evidence bundle for the reclassified rows (tax IDs and timestamps) so Finance can release the hold.
- Add a small reconciliation script (I can prototype) to re-run attribution for midnight-slice rows and surface differences automatically each cycle (JIRA BILL-7782).

I attached a short CSV (redwood_forwarded_notes.txt) with the mapping of CloudOps row -> our entity id. Happy to walk through this on a quick call.

Karthik
Senior Marketplace Integrations Engineer
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_forwarded_notes.txt

Claire — thanks for the quick response and attachments. Per Karthik's analysis we need a credit memo for the reclassified rows plus a VAT evidence bundle so AP (Acme) will clear the payout hold. Can you confirm the following and send the evidence bundle to both us and Acme's AP team:

1) A corrected per-line export with the reclassified SKU column populated.
2) VAT evidence: tax ID, billing timestamp, buyer country, and the tagging job logs showing the re-run. We need explicit records for the ~1,120 affected rows.
3) Confirmation of whether CloudOps will issue an immediate credit memo or adjust in the next cycle. If immediate credit, please include the draft credit memo PDF and a DocuSign link if signature is required.

We'll hold the payout release until we receive the evidence bundle and the credit memo (or written commitment for next-cycle correction). Please send the items to: accounts-payable@acmeclient.com and cc marissa_cole@redwood.com.

If helpful we can schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow morning to walk the bundle.
